ten: Phim mẫu · Little Sơn Tinh — hai thế giới, cắt khớp (tham khảo, không sinh video)
mo_ta: PHIM MẪU THAM KHẢO dựng theo cách phim 'Thánh Gióng' (Seedance 2.5, tham-khao/thanh-giong/README.md): truyền thuyết và đời thật chạy song song, nối bằng cắt khớp hành động / hướng / màu / hình; mỗi thế giới một vỏ hình (truyền thuyết khung 2.39 viền đen, xanh ngọc + vàng; đời thật đầy khung, tầm mắt trẻ con); motif con gà nối hai thế giới. CHỈ kịch bản + bảng shot, không sinh ảnh / video.

kinh_thanh.phong_cach: Photoreal cinematic live-action short film, natural film grain, shallow depth of field, rich but believable color. Two visual worlds that never mix: LEGEND world: epic mythic Dong Son bronze-age Vietnam, anamorphic 2.39:1 letterboxed frame with solid black bars top and bottom, deep teal-and-jade storm palette with molten gold highlights, low heroic camera, volumetric mist. REAL world: full-frame 16:9, photoreal Central Vietnam village during flood season, camera at a child's eye level, natural light. Clean frames with no text, letters or logos.
kinh_thanh.logline: On the night the river floods her grandfather's house, eight-year-old Na — who plays at being the Mountain God — has to hold back the water for real.
kinh_thanh.chu_de: Legends are what ordinary people do when the water rises

nhan_vat.mo_ta: Eight-year-old Vietnamese girl from Central Vietnam, short black bob with a few wet strands, round face, bright stubborn eyes, slightly chipped front tooth; faded sky-blue cotton shirt and dark shorts under an oversized bright YELLOW plastic raincoat with hood; barefoot. Her raincoat yellow is the same yellow as the Mountain God's sash.

Na's grandfather, about 72, thin and wiry, sun-dark skin, short white stubble, kind deep wrinkles; faded brown collarless shirt, black trousers rolled to the knee, old conical leaf hat; moves slowly with a sore back but strong hands.

LEGEND: the Mountain God as a young Dong Son warrior-king, about 25, calm determined face, long black hair tied high; bronze scale armor engraved with Dong Son drum patterns (sun star, flying cranes), a long GOLDEN-YELLOW sash streaming from the waist, jade staff; moves the earth with his hands. Same eyes and face shape as Na (match cut).

LEGEND: the Water God, tall and furious, armor of blue-green fish scales that shine wet, long hair flowing like waves, rides the crest of giant storm waves with a sea serpent coiled beneath; surrounded by rain and lightning.

Na's rooster: a proud red-and-golden village rooster with a tall red comb, glossy dark-green tail feathers and long sharp spurs. In the LEGEND world the same rooster appears as the nine-spurred rooster (gà chín cựa) on the Mountain God's gauntlet.
A knee-high cairn of smooth grey river pebbles Na stacks in the yard into a little pointed 'mountain', topped by one flat white stone.
Woven white polypropylene rice sacks, half full, tied with red plastic string.

A small one-storey Central Vietnam brick house with a red tiled roof and a wooden loft (gác lửng) under the roof reached by a bamboo ladder; a swept brick front yard, a bamboo chicken coop, banana trees, a low wall; a brown river 30 meters behind; green Truong Son mountains on the horizon. Day: warm afternoon gold. Night: cold blue rain, one oil lamp inside.

LEGEND landscape: jagged limestone peaks rising out of a sea of clouds and an endless stormy sea, ancient Dong Son era, no buildings except a distant stilt palace; teal storm sky broken by gold light.

tap.brief: Phim mẫu 2 phút: đêm lũ, Na (8 tuổi) cùng ông nội cứu lúa, cứu gà, chặn nước ở cửa — mỗi hành động của Na cắt khớp sang Sơn Tinh dâng núi chặn Thủy Tinh. Bình minh: nước rút, gà gáy trên nóc nhà, núi đá của Na còn đứng; vũng nước phản chiếu bóng Sơn Tinh trên dãy núi thật.
